generated_config.label: Generated config path
generated_config.description: KDL file the panel writes display settings to. Include it from your niri config with: include "displays-generated.kdl"

persist.label: Save changes to the niri config
persist.description: niri's IPC output changes are temporary and are forgotten on the next config reload. With this on, every change is also written to the generated KDL file so it survives a reload or reboot.
